title: /s/ sharing token link: Unresolved with site and item type hints (BC-011)

method.text: Recognised a sharing token link (/s/ variant, PDF or other binary file) for site SiteA. The token cannot be decoded without signing in, so the path, library and folder are unknown. Authenticated validation can resolve it.

hints.label: item type from the link prefix ":b:"
site name from the sharing link (whether it lives under /sites/ or /teams/ is not known)
